player_prompt.intro:
UnguMdlali {player_id} udlala umdlalo we-Pig Dice.

Imithetho:
- Ngexesha lakho, ungaweza ukuthi '[roll]' okanye '[hold]'
- Gwintsa 2-6: Ongeza kwi-jongile yakho yexesha
- Gwintsa 1: Usala jongile yakho yexesha uyekwe
- Hold: Ongeza jongile yakho yexesha kwi-jongile yakho uyekwe
- Oqala ukufika kwi-{winning_score} amaponti uphumelele

Xa kuyiyo exesha lakho, uyakubona amajongile akhoyo nejongile yexesha.
Impendulo ngokuthi '[roll]' ukugwintsa idayisi okanye '[hold]' ukubanka amaponti akho.
